deviations: RFC-401 A1 (design §2.4): every Agent writer deduplicates the four reference fields; the II-b parent-target uniqueness question is settled for writes (existing duplicate rows are normalized on the next save).
Package closure and legacy workflow reverse matcher historically accept agentId on any node kind.
Workflow delete compares name across all owners and ignores cached ids.
Fusion restore-only composition has no seed participant because recovery never seeds.
